conclusion: The two unchanged original loader bodies read the selected original CSVs, and the tested retained scenario and knowledge-point references resolved. No defect was found in these parsing/map/reference checks.
counterevidence: Original and authored loader passes both use csv.DictReader and identical documented type conversions, so agreement is not an independent CSV implementation and cannot detect a shared parser interpretation problem. It does establish the finite original-API map correspondence when combined with separate row/key/membership counters. Referential closure alone also does not prove every KP lies within the simulator fixed1..50index domain, prerequisite acyclicity, conceptual/content uniqueness or pedagogical accuracy; none was measured or claimed.
limits: Interaction/student-history CSV was not read; future-response incidence, chronology/cutoff eligibility, repeated-question behavior and label truth remain unobserved.
The generator uses synthetic IRT/BKT-style data; no real learner quality, calibration, education authority, M1–M5 performance or holdout effectiveness conclusion.
No constructor/full module/scorer/inference/NumPy/native/model/provider/auth/network execution or new19-helper controls. This is unrelated to held SolV8/model-runner work, with no retry or reroute.
Original scorer may prefer post-test lists from ground truth. This run joined only retained scenario lists; it does not claim an exhaustive census of every question consumed by all scoring branches.
Private bodies and existing200scenario hashes are reused exactly; reviewer did not reopen, stat or rehash them. No private rows/IDs exported.
No rights, complete installed-image parity, certification, exclusion or new issue/task-breadth change.
